summary: Between June 1 and June 13, 2026, some Enterprise Managed User accounts that were deprovisioned through SCIM were incorrectly deleted instead of being suspended and obfuscated as expected. As a result, affected users appeared as ghost users in issues, pull requests, and audit logs, rather than retaining their expected suspended and obfuscated user records within the enterprise.
takeaways: GitHub is restoring the affected accounts.
What caused the issue On June 1, 2026, GitHub enabled a change that routed deprovisioning requests through a new path.
GitHub contained the issue by disabling the affected path on June 13, 2026.
